clarity.notes: Brand switch is a single documented rule: ?brand=the-era flips html[data-brand], same as the sister Selfbooth prototype. Default Poze URL is untouched.

hierarchy.notes: Same 11-screen layout and chrome positions as the default. Hierarchy is now weight-driven (Manrope 800) with the condensed uppercase stack removed, so the espresso display text still lands first on the beige canvas.

typography.notes: One modern geometric sans (Manrope 400-800) carries all display tiers plus a Be Vietnam Pro body tier; Vietnamese diacritics intact (UTF-8 verified). Wordmark is a text lockup — The Era in caramel + muted 'booth' — replacing the PÓZE raster logo.

motion.notes: No new motion this pass; existing screen fades, countdown ring and flash are untouched and correctly re-toned (ring stroke bound to caramel, flash pinned to a light surface).

brand.notes: Beige #f3ebdd canvas + light-wood accents + one deep-caramel accent, mapped onto the existing token set with no raw hex outside the token block. Light-on-dark inversions fixed: status pills/keys/scan-tab/dark nav take --status-fg, QR card and flash pinned to --surface.
